notes.title: DLC3 'Martial Arts Tournament' of Slime Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
DLC3 "Martial Arts Tournament" is now available! Milim joins the game as a playable character!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/842bc05bd937f63013d3e293f5568d3a7e2a9ac4.jpg

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 3 “Martial Arts Tournament',” is now available and Milim now joins the game as a playable character!

In DLC3, a new martial arts tournament is being held in Tempest, where players will have to win battles against various powerful opponents in order to arise victorious. Players can choose one of 12 characters to challenge and enjoy each character’s unique stories. The DLC also adds four new sub-quests and five new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level.  

■DLC3 is now available to purchase and will include:
Additional Scenario:  'Martial Arts Tournament' 
Playable Character: 'Milim'
Additional Side Quest: 4 Types 
Additional Building: 5 Types

The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/52c8c35ac57e3ea70c0443ea703fc8e461a3451d.jpg

Check out the new video introducing DLC3!

notes.title: DLC2 "The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth" of Slime Console Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
DLC2 “The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth” is now available! Veldora joins the game as a playable character!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/e65fdc2c19be0fe0c2e72ac3f2982a292628d4f4.jpg

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 2 “The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth,” is now available and Veldora now joins the game as a playable character!

The DLC also introduces a new mode where players can explore the original labyrinth built by Demon Lord Ramiris alongside the revived Veldora, pushing their limits as they take on a 100-level dungeon packed with formidable monsters. Additionally, the DLC includes five new sub-quests and seven new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level. 

■DLC2 is now available to purchase and will include:

The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass.

notes.title: The First DLC "A Strange Fate" of Slime Console Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
First DLC “A Strange Fate” is now available! Hinata joins the game as a playable character!

[previewyoutube=Ogf1TI8zZNM;full][/previewyoutube]

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 1 “A Strange Fate,” is now available. “A Strange Fate” is the first of three currently planned DLC releases for the title, with additional content coming later this year in September. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/ba1a9621e5e88e0b95e89b95043ba191572e5904.jpg

The first-ever action RPG based on the multifaceted series will now allow players to go on a journey to find Hinata, Sumire’s childhood friend and captain of the Western Holy Church's Crusaders. In the “A Strange Fate” DLC, players will control Sumire instead of the titular character Rimuru. The DLC also adds ten new sub-quests and seven new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level.  

■DLC1 is now available to purchase and will include:
Additional Scenario : A Strange Fate
Playable Character :Hinata
Additional Side Quest: 10 Types
Additional Buildings: 7 Types

The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/52c8c35ac57e3ea70c0443ea703fc8e461a3451d.jpg

notes.title: It's time to reincarnate into your next adventure!
notes.content:
Experience a slice of the Jura Tempest Federation life with friends

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/c583c101635a411c988a36fbdac5cef2055e001c.jpg

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime originated from the web novel submission site, 'Shōsetsuka ni Narō', and has since been featured in various media platforms, finally has its first console game!

Conquer powerful enemies through thrilling action, develop your village with friends, and immerse yourself in the exclusive narrative of the "Tempest Story".  

Get a glimpse of the unique gameplay experience in That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles in launch trailer, available here:
[previewyoutube=potI2n2s5Oo;full][/previewyoutube]

▼Experience Stories from the Anime, as well as All-New Adventures
Users can experience the anime story by encountering the Kijin in the battle against the Kingdom of Falmuth. Dive into an entirely new original story supervised by the original author, featuring characters drawn from the original story. The game’s story will also confront a new and powerful enemy. 

▼Action-Packed Battles with Exhilarating Combo Attacks
In battle, players can make full use of the special moves with animations and perform flashy combos in the side-scrolling action. 

▼Exciting City-Building
Additionally, this title introduces a building element, where rewards gained from fighting, fuel the nation's growth. The unique growth system in this title allows each characters’ status to be strengthened, by building and enriching facilities in the Jura Tempest Federation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197680/That_Time_I_Got_Reincarnated_as_a_Slime_ISEKAI_Chronicles/

notes.title: SLIME's first action RPG is coming on August 8!
notes.content:
Experience a slice of the Jura Tempest Federation life with friends

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/cdf9b58dc48ac6590c06d9ba5077255fa308f551.png

☆Action-Packed Battles with Exhilarating Combo Attacks

Players can enjoy thrilling action battles that combine flashy special moves and powerful combos. Through leveling up bonds with friends, Rimuru will learn Special Attacks, and even have allies join in to back up Rimiru’s attack. Finish off formidable enemies that are coming to destroy Tempest with Special Skills animated in retro 8-bit style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/23d08f7889c1705172527d4cc6c98d0c31cc4130.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/ceb42c274ba6eba9c63e037b1f6362898c7e04bd.png

☆Experience Stories from the Anime, as well as All-New Adventures

Relive the original story from the encounter with the Kijin to the battle against the Kingdom of Falmuth fully voiced! In addition, there are two brand new adventures from the original author for fans to enjoy! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/b7379651b0733be201521cb0d128085cf30f5857.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/d85c97e8bd3e6452dc5c43a9bc1556b711383e2e.png

☆Exciting City-Building

As players progress through the story and meet new allies, their community will grow from a small village to a great nation. Build a wide variety of buildings to take advantage of the Tempest Resonance which strengthens residents as you create more structures in your village! There are even modern Japanese-style buildings that make use of Rimuru's memory from the world before his reincarnation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/65e79029cf66da98421a09c903964078349e0efb.png

There are also more than 50 original subquests to enjoy! Enjoy the daily life in Tempest with laughter and tears as Rimuru and his friends work together to solve residents' problems and make the country a better place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/aac23295dcea3f074c64ddf7f9f8dc7d712bfacd.png

More details about the game will be released in the coming days on the official website.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197680/
